clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau was teaching a memory seminar to make money - that was the whole plan.

At the break, a father came up in tears. His daughter had been depressed about school. That day she memorized all 50 states and their capitals, walked in, and proved her teacher wrong.

He went back to the office and told his team: stop thinking about the next sale. Think about how to help people more.

The moment the focus shifted off the money, the business exploded - he said it flowed in like lava, and nobody could stop it.

Where in your business are you focused on the sale instead of the person?
